jobs.name: ig5_host
jobs.person_note: The woman must be exactly the presenter from the attached board (same face, red hair in a ponytail).
jobs.meaning: ведущая с борда «Блокнот» ~27: рыжие волосы в хвосте, белая футболка и жёлтый кардиган, фон — светлая стена цвета бумаги с лёгкой клеткой; по пояс, обе руки в кадре, лицо нейтральное, губы приоткрыты, без улыбки, фотореализм, без надписей
jobs.prompt: Photorealistic photograph, vertical 9:16, of exactly the presenter woman from the attached board (same face, red hair in a ponytail) — a confident, likeable storyteller about 27, NOT a fashion model, natural skin texture and freckles. FRAMING (very important): waist-up, centred, BOTH shoulders and BOTH arms fully inside the frame with generous margin (at least 12% of width) on left and right, hands relaxed at waist level holding nothing. Top of the head about 18% of frame height below the upper edge; face large and sharp. Expression: lively eyes, face NEUTRAL as in the middle of a sentence: lips slightly parted with a hint of teeth, NO smile. Clothes: white T-shirt and a mustard-yellow #FFD447 cardigan. Background: a plain warm cream wall #FAF6EC with a very faint squared-paper grid, softly out of focus, bright soft daylight. No text, no letters, no logos, nothing covering the face, no headphones, no microphone.

jobs.name: ig5_tv
jobs.style: Hand-drawn pencil SKETCH illustration in the «Блокнот» look from the attached design board: graphite #2B2B2B line art with light hatching on cream squared notebook paper #FAF6EC, a few accents in red pencil #D7263D and yellow marker #FFD447, like a smart doodle explainer. Clean, readable, centred composition with paper margin around. Absolutely NO readable text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos anywhere; lists are drawn as abstract scribble lines.
jobs.style_qa: рисованный карандашный скетч на бумаге в клетку в стиле борда «Блокнот» (графит, красный карандаш, жёлтый маркер), без читаемых надписей, букв и цифр, смысл соответствует описанию
jobs.meaning: человек ночью на диване смотрит сериал, на экране прогресс-бар серии, рука с пультом замерла
